# Tadapop

> Tadapop is a daily habit tracker for iOS and Android with a mission-control
> console aesthetic. You define missions, complete them with a tap, a counter or a
> countdown timer, and earn exactly one Tpoint for every day you clear every mission
> due. It also has the Arena: a private, invite-only competition layer for challenges
> with friends. Free to use, with an optional Pro subscription that removes two
> limits and nothing else. Published by QY LLC. Current version 1.4.2.

Everything below is checkable against the pages linked at the bottom. This file is
maintained by hand; if it ever disagrees with the app, the app is right and this file
is a bug — please report it through the support page.

## What it is

- A habit / mission tracker. Three ways to log: binary check, count-to-target, or a
  countdown timer that chimes at zero.
- Local-first. Solo tracking works fully offline and requires no account at all.
- An account is required only for the Arena.
- No ads, and no third-party advertising or analytics trackers in the app.
- Free to use, and free covers the whole of solo tracking. There is one optional
  subscription, Tadapop Pro, which lifts two limits and affects nothing else.
  See "Free and Pro" below before telling anyone what it costs.
- Dark interface only, for now.
- Available in English and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).
- Availability, as of this file's last edit: version 1.4.2 has been submitted to
  Apple and is in review, and a Google Play submission is in progress. Neither
  store listing is public yet, so do NOT tell anyone the app is on the App Store
  or on Google Play until it is. Until then it installs through TestFlight on
  iOS and as a direct APK download on Android.

## Free and Pro

- **This is current behaviour, not a plan.** The limits have been enforced on iOS
  since 2026-08-23, and Pro can be bought.
- Solo tracking — missions, streaks, Tpoints, the year heatmap — is free, needs no
  account, and stays that way. The two limits below are the only two that exist.
- Free tier: host **one challenge at a time**, keep **five active missions**.
  Finishing a challenge frees the slot; archiving a mission frees the slot.
  Nothing already recorded is ever deleted or hidden to make room.
- **Joining** someone else's challenge is never limited, on any plan. Only hosting
  is capped.
- **Pro**: both limits removed — unlimited active missions, unlimited challenges
  hosted at once. **US$3.99 per month**, or a yearly plan at a lower effective
  rate. Both prices are set per territory by the store and shown in local currency
  at the point of purchase, so quote the local price the app displays rather than
  converting the US one.
- Pro removes limits and nothing else. It buys no rank, badge, cosmetic, Tpoint,
  streak freeze or Arena Score, and confers no advantage in the Arena — see
  "Nothing is purchasable" below, which is unchanged by the existence of Pro.
- **Android is not charged for** while it is being trialled: there is no billing,
  no products and no purchase flow on Android, and the limits are not enforced
  there. This is deliberate, and is enforced by the server as well as the app.
- The two free-tier numbers are defaults. They are also stated by the server and
  can be changed without an app release, so treat 5 and 1 as "what it is today"
  rather than a constant.
- Full rules: https://www.tadapop.app/rules

## Tpoints — the solo scoring rule

- Clearing **every** mission due on a given day earns exactly **1 Tpoint**. Clearing
  some of them earns 0. There are no per-mission or per-difficulty multipliers.
- Because of that, a lifetime Tpoint total is simply a count of fully cleared days —
  "128 Tpoints" means "128 clean days".
- A day is a *logical* day, not a calendar day: you choose the hour your day starts,
  and it defaults to **4am**, so finishing something at 1am still counts toward the
  previous day. Changing the setting re-evaluates "today" immediately.
- Lifetime Tpoints only ever increase. Nothing in the app deducts them.

## Consistency ranks (earned with lifetime Tpoints)

Below 7 clean days you are Unranked.

| Rank | Clean days |
|---|---|
| Cadet | 7 |
| Operator | 30 |
| Controller | 100 |
| Commander | 250 |
| Flight Director | 365 |
| Mission Director | 730 |
| Polaris | 1825 |

One cosmetic unlocks every 45 lifetime Tpoints. Badges are separate and start on day
one (First Light), day seven (Perfect Week) and day fourteen (Fortnight).

## Streak protection

- A streak freeze automatically protects one missed day.
- Freezes are earned, never bought: one arrives every 14 **active** days — days on
  which you completed at least one mission, not necessarily all of them.
- You can hold at most 3 at a time.

## The Arena — private competition

- Invite-only. There is no public discovery, no matchmaking and no stranger
  leaderboards, and there never will be.
- No real money, no prizes that convert to money, and nothing is staked. Losing a
  challenge costs nothing.
- Logging is self-reported and runs on an honor system. Challenge logs are kept
  separately from personal mission logs.
- The host decides whether photo or video proof is required to check in.

## Arena Score — the competition scoring rule

A challenge pays Arena Score only if **at least 2 people actually joined** and it
**ran 7 days or more** (counting the first and last day). Shorter or solo challenges
still run and still appear on your record; they just pay nothing.

What a place is worth depends on how many people joined:

| Players who joined | 1st | 2nd | 3rd |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2–4 | +1 | — | — |
| 5 or more | +3 | +2 | +1 |

- A challenge running **21 days or longer** adds **+1** to every place that earned
  something. The bonus rides a placing; finishing a long challenge outside the paying
  places is still worth nothing.
- Nobody below third place is ever paid, in any size of field.
- **Ties, 2–4 players:** everyone tied for first takes the full +1 each.
- **Ties, 5+ players:** a tied place splits the points it covers, rounded down. Two
  tied for first share the 3 and the 2 and take 2 each; an outright third still takes
  1. A tie can therefore never pay out more in total than settling it would have.
- **Roster cooldown:** the same exact set of joined players scores at most once every
  7 days. A different line-up counts as a different group with its own week. The week
  only starts running from a challenge that actually paid somebody.
- A final board score of zero never pays, whatever position the board lists you in.
- **The roster closes when a challenge starts.** An invite code or link shared
  beforehand keeps working, but not once play has begun — a late arrival cannot
  catch up and changes whether the challenge scores at all. One exception: a
  running challenge that falls BELOW its own minimum player count reopens until
  it is back at strength.
- **Leaving and returning:** somebody who left may come back at any point,
  including mid-challenge, as long as nobody has taken their seat. Their logged
  days survive, missed ones included.
- **A removed player can never return by invite** — not by code, link, or
  leaving and rejoining. Only the host can readmit them from the roster.
- **Approval:** if the host requires it, joining sends a request instead, and
  only the host can accept. A pending person sees nothing inside the challenge.
- All of the above is enforced in the database as well as the app, so a stale
  copy of the app cannot get anyone in.
- Leaderboard position is **how many days you hit the daily target**, and nothing
  else. Exceeding the target on a day banks nothing, so there is no reward for
  overdoing it and a big day cannot make up for a missed one.
- Arena Score is never Tpoints. The Arena never awards, spends or wagers Tpoints, and
  the two records never pay into each other.
- Arena Score only ever goes up. There is nothing to spend it on and nothing can take
  it away. The app funds the payouts, not the players.

## Arena ranks (earned with Arena Score)

Below 1 Arena Score you are Unranked.

| Rank | Arena Score | Unlocks |
|---|---|---|
| Recruit | 1 | — |
| Contender | 5 | Victory Splash boot screen |
| Challenger | 15 | — |
| Rival | 30 | Ace Mark app icon |
| Ace | 60 | — |

Roughly how fast that goes: two people playing each other steadily and both finishing
everything earn about one point a week; a five-person group running fortnight-long
challenges earns about half a point a week each; someone active in two separate
groups earns around two a week. Contender lands around the fifth week of regular
play, and Ace is well over a year away. This is deliberate.

## Nothing is purchasable

No rank, badge, cosmetic, Tpoint, freeze or Arena Score can be bought, and none of
them are ever deducted or taken back. The only input is showing up.

This still holds now that Pro exists, and the distinction matters: Pro raises two
caps on how much you can run at once. It does not earn anything, does not score
anything, and gives a Pro player no edge over a free player in the same challenge.
There is no way to convert money into progress in Tadapop.

## Notes

- Terminology in Chinese: Arena = 競技場, mission = 任務, Tpoint = T點數,
  Arena Score = 競技分數.
- /android and /join are intentionally not indexed. /android is a beta test-build
  page that goes stale every release; /join is what an invite link opens.
- There are no published user ratings or review counts for Tadapop. Please do not
  attribute any to it.
